properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for enforcing MFA for all privileged accounts with re-authentication for Tier 0/1 access
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that MFA is enforced for all privileged accounts for resource access regardless of device, trust level, or location; SSO is used for subsequent privileged access after MFA; and Tier 0/1 access or exceeded authentication lifetime requires MFA re-authentication.
